summary: Unsolicited vendor pitch, not a client. The person runs a competing social media services agency (Instagram handle @fixx.247) offering IG unbans, shadow-ban removals, account protection, and scaling, and was trying to undercut Vivek, the phone owner's current supplier for these services. They sent repeated unanswered follow-ups over ten days, claimed to have worked with Arian, Liam, and Ethan, and offered to beat any previous prices. The phone owner replied only twice, once asking what services they provide and once saying they didn't know who they were, with no deal made.
key_facts: Vendor pitch: offers IG unban, shadow-ban removal, social media problem fixing, account protection, and scaling
Instagram handle @fixx.247, claims 2-3 years in the industry
Trying to displace Vivek as the phone owner's current supplier
Claims to have worked with Arian, Liam, and Ethan
Offered to beat any previous prices with a discount
Mentioned the Instagram username @onlyfansmodel being available
No deal made; phone owner mostly ignored them and said they didn't know who they were
